turns.query: Consider the road segments whose geometry lies within 300 metres of Causeway Bay air-quality station (station_id 17). Restricting to June 2025 hours (2025-06-01 to 2025-06-30) in which the hourly NO2 at station 17 exceeded 100, identify which of those road segments had the highest mean congestion_index over those hours (non-NULL values, from the hourly road-segment traffic records). Return that road_segment_id and its mean congestion_index.

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# First, get station 17 coordinates and find road segments within 300m
query = text("""
SELECT rs.id as road_segment_id, rs.length, rs.geometry
FROM road_segment rs
CROSS JOIN air_quality_station aqs
WHERE aqs.id = 17
AND ST_DWithin(rs.geometry::geography, aqs.coordinate::geography, 300)
""")
segments_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"Road segments within 300m of station 17: {len(segments_df)}")
print(segments_df.head())

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Get the segment IDs
segment_ids = segments_df['road_segment_id'].tolist()
print(f"Segment IDs: {segment_ids}")

# Query traffic data for June 2025 hours where station 17 NO2 > 100
# Join with hourly_station_air_quality to filter by NO2 condition
query = text(f"""
SELECT hrst.road_segment_id, hrst.congestion_index
FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic hrst
JOIN hourly_station_air_quality hsaq ON hrst.datetime = hsaq.datetime
WHERE hrst.road_segment_id IN ({','.join(map(str, segment_ids))})
AND hsaq.station_id = 17
AND hsaq.datetime >= '2025-06-01'
AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-07-01'
AND hsaq.no2 > 100
AND hrst.congestion_index IS NOT NULL
""")
traffic_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"Total traffic records: {len(traffic_df)}")
print(traffic_df.head())

import pandas as pd

# Calculate mean congestion_index per road segment
mean_ci = traffic_df.groupby('road_segment_id')['congestion_index'].mean().reset_index()
mean_ci.columns = ['road_segment_id', 'mean_congestion_index']
mean_ci = mean_ci.sort_values('mean_congestion_index', ascending=False)
print(mean_ci)

# Get the worst segment
worst = mean_ci.iloc[0]
print(f"\nWorst segment ID: {int(worst['road_segment_id'])}")
print(f"Worst segment mean CI: {worst['mean_congestion_index']:.2f}")

# Store results
worst_segment_id = int(worst['road_segment_id'])
worst_segment_ci = round(worst['mean_congestion_index'], 2)
